# Vendored Preact

Preact and preact-render-to-string, copied verbatim from npm so that JsxCore ships a working
runtime without anything to install. Both are MIT licensed; the licences are beside this file.

| Package | Version |
|---|---|
| preact | 10.29.7 |
| preact-render-to-string | 6.7.0 |

Nothing here is edited. To update, reinstall the packages and copy the same files again; the
versions above and `VendoredPreact.Versions` have to move together, because the build id is
derived from them.
